name: Sweet Summer Dreamin' -Kono Natsu Yume Miru Musume-tachi-
original_name: Sweet Summer Dreamin’ -この夏・夢みる娘たち-
source:
Hero gives a ride to gentleman walking across the bridge and gets an offer to work for him as a driver as a result. The gentleman turns out to be an enterprise chief, and working for him will get hero acquainted with many women from chief's entourage.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-january-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
英雄载着一位走过桥的绅士，结果得到了为他当司机的工作机会。这位先生原来是一位企业老总，为他工作会让英雄结识很多老总随从的女人。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-january-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
